hmx_precision: FP16 input and intermediate; FP32 quantization parameters; final normalization folded into scale.
historical_data: Initial FP32: report-v8.txt/manifest-v8.json. Prior HMX: prior_kernel_measurement. Prior E2E: e2e/paired. Cache growth/readers=8 experiments rejected; see decode-optimization/rejected-runtime-tuning.txt.

prior_kernel_measurement.rotation: Full H44 x H64 at 2816 and H44 x H16 at 704; three independent H704 dense chunks, not H2112.
prior_kernel_measurement.baseline: rotation off in the same final DSP binary
prior_kernel_measurement.primary_measurement: 1024 tokens, RMSNorm included, fixed synthetic routing, 48 samples per variant and weight format
prior_kernel_measurement.aggregate: Sum of separately measured kernel medians, not full-model TTFT.
prior_kernel_measurement.weights: Synthetic packed 2-bit 128 experts top8; synthetic 4-bit three dense chunks.

pooled_result.bootstrap_note: Observed runs only; does not model other routing, thermal conditions, full-model TTFT or model quality.

prior_kernel_measurement.scope_correction: The synthetic 4-bit benchmark uses 704 x 3, whereas actual PR #4416 shared FFN uses 1056 x 2. The 4.48% synthetic sum is NOT actual shared FFN or E2E overhead and is not model-level target evidence.

rotation: 2-bit experts only: normalized H44 x H64 at Up/Gate 2816, H44 x H16 at Down 704. Actual shared 4-bit FFN 1056 x 2 remains unrotated.
decode_precision: FP32 HVX, including both_hmx at M <= 4; H44 QFloat accumulators remain inside asm before FP32 stores.
baseline: Rotation off in the SAME final normal DSP binary; expert cache=16, grow=0, readers=4, CPU threads=8, DMA queues=4. KV configuration unchanged.
primary_measurement: Pure rotation: fixed-routing real-rotation MoE kernel; actual whole-app E2E and a separate decode rotate/restore control. Do not pool the normal and diagnostic binaries.
weights: Existing unrotated 7.54 GB Gemma4-26B-A4B, QS2CX_WH experts and QS4CX rest; embedding/LM head Q4_0. Speed experiment, no model-quality validation.
routing_caveat: Online rotations on an unrotated checkpoint change routing and generated IDs. E2E differences include different expert work/cache misses, not only the arithmetic cost of rotation.

decode_cache16_final.status: 8-run pooled median +4.84%, but confirmation batch +6.27%; not a stable below-5% claim.

prior_decode_tuning.status: Superseded. Reader/cache tuning is rejected by user; only cache=16, grow=0, readers=4 may be used for final evaluation.

input_reuse_workspace.lifetime: one shared row per graph; invalidated per logical MoE op/token, independent of expert cache

actual_e2e_final.status: Prefill +1.32%; raw decode +6.98%, NOT below 5%. Unrotated checkpoint changes routing and cache misses; not pure rotation cost.

shadow_decode_control.status: Diagnostic-only rotate/restore control: +0.636% decode including save/restore copies; not a real rotated-model E2E claim.

publication_note: The uncommitted flag describes the original measurement snapshot. Publication checks are recorded separately in publication-checks/summary.json; original source and measurement hashes are retained.
